# VESTIBULE — Emoji / Placeholder Art Inventory

*Generated by full source + on-disk asset audit. Purpose: find EVERY emoji rendered in place of real
artwork so the remaining art can be produced before release.*

**How art loads (placeholder vs real):** `CardArtImg`/`ArtifactArtImg`/`PackArtImg` probe for a PNG on
disk and **fall back to the entity's `emoji` field when the PNG is missing**. So an emoji is a *live
placeholder* only when its target PNG does not exist. Members/bosses use fixed portrait maps
(`MemberPortrait`, `BOSS_PORTRAITS`). Hardcoded UI emoji (menu buttons, drug shelf, keyword icons,
rules page) have **no image loader at all** — they are always the emoji.

Legend: ✅ = real art on disk · ❌ = emoji placeholder (needs art) · ⚠ = art exists but is orphaned/unused.

### Total distinct DATA-DRIVEN asset PNGs still empty on disk: **62**
`29 artifacts + 25 pedals + 3 boss loot + 2 card packs + 3 tutorial enemies = 62`
> **5 of those are recoverable for free** — `a3, a8, wardrums, ca2, ca3` already have PNGs in
> `public/vestibule/artifacts/` but were *reclassified to pedals*, which load from
> `public/vestibule/passives/`. **Move those 5 files** and the pedal gap drops from 25 → 20 (net truly-new = **57**).

Beyond the data-driven assets there are **~45 hardcoded UI/gameplay emoji** (menu buttons, shop
headers, drug icons, keyword icons, rules-page icons, combat HUD) that have no art pipeline at all —
listed in their own sections below. These are a design call (many read fine as icons), but the brief
asked for "EVERY area," so they are all captured.

## DECORATIVE OCCULT DINGBATS — intentional typography, almost certainly KEEP (confirm with dev)

These are used as **text ornaments / borders / tier ribbons**, not as objects that should become
artwork. They appear pervasively:

| Glyph | Typical use |
|---|---|
| ⛧ | Section headers, buttons, riff-chain flashes, borders (e.g. `⛧ · ✠ · ☥` divider rows) |
| ✠ | Border/divider ornament (SVG card frames 4215/11867, divider rows) |
| ☥ | Divider-row ankh ornament (2561, 2857, 4087, 11570, 12373…) |
| ✦ / ✨ | Mythic / Foil tier ribbons on cards & members |
| 🜏 / 🜺 | Alchemical glyphs used AS the emoji for two artifacts (Pentagram Shrine, Inverted Pentacle) — these ARE placeholders, listed under Artifacts |
| 𓂀 | Egyptian eye used as the Sigil of Set artifact emoji — placeholder, listed under Artifacts |
| ✟ | Inverted Cross mythic artifact emoji — placeholder, listed under Artifacts |
| ★ | Menu title flourish |
| ⚗ / 💿 | Log prefixes for "artifact equipped" / "pedal equipped" (text) |
| ♦ | Member-alive marker |

Note the four "alchemical/occult" glyphs (🜏 🜺 𓂀 ✟) double as **actual artifact `emoji` placeholders**,
so they still need artwork even though they read as typography — they are counted in the Artifacts
section, not here.

   `public/vestibule/artifacts/` → `public/vestibule/passives/`. Pedal gap 25 → 20.
2. **Card packs (2):** `packs/cassette.png`, `packs/cdr.png` (TODO #7).
3. **Boss loot (3):** limbos_echo, berserker_rage, heretics_brand.
4. **Tutorial enemies (3):** tut_shade, tut_wraith, tut_revenant (or reuse a generic ghost).
5. **Artifacts (29)** and **remaining pedals (20)** — the bulk of the work.
6. **Optional polish:** wire the existing `pacts/{deck}.png` into the deck picker; add hardcoded-UI
   icon art for menu buttons / keyword icons / drug icons if a more finished look is wanted; the
   18 `stoned/` member GIFs.

**Bottom line: 62 data-driven asset PNGs are empty (57 truly new after the 5 free moves), plus ~45
hardcoded UI/gameplay emoji that are a design call.**
